sub_service: Non-functional streetlight complaint via the Goa Electricity Department's general contact channel
description: goaelectricity.gov.in (the Government of Goa's own Electricity Department domain) has a navigation section explicitly titled 'Open Access & Streetlight Matters' -- fetched directly, confirming streetlights fall under this department's remit (public lighting duty, the standard mechanism by which municipalities pay the electricity board for street lighting in India), not the municipal ULB portal used for Waste/Water/Roads (see GA_ULB_SERVICE_* records in this same file, which explicitly do NOT list a streetlight option). The streetlight-specific page itself only contains legal/billing sub-sections (Open Access Procedure, Goa Public Lighting Duty Act, the 2021 Bill & Act, and the Duty rate) with no dedicated complaint form or contact -- so this record uses the department's own general contact channel, confirmed on the same domain's Contact Us page: toll-free 1912, a direct line for complaints from outside Goa (91-832-2485500), and an email (customersupport@goaelectricity.gov.in). No streetlight-specific SLA was found.
procedure: Call the toll-free number (1912) or, from outside Goa, 91-832-2485500, or email customersupport@goaelectricity.gov.in; the source pages offer no streetlight-specific routing beyond this department-wide general contact.
sla: SLA NOT FOUND for streetlight complaints specifically -- the contact channel is real and confirmed, and the department is confirmed responsible for streetlights, but no published numeric response/resolution time exists on any reachable page.
